scope: Twentieth bounded target-specific wave: eight current completion-unproved eMAR targets; one direct OpenEMR allergy-API recommendation and seven conservative retained-unproved outcomes.

methodology.runtime_boundary: No application, browser, database, deployment or product Git state was changed.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Evidence is behavioural only; do not copy source, schema, UI, wording or distinctive layouts.
methodology.direct_rule: A recommendation requires target-specific neutral job alignment at pinned official community-source loci. Generic related-person, administration, audit or break-glass primitives remain unproved.
methodology.reuse_rule: OpenEMR paths have no current 902 mapping hits. The reused Bahmni administration DAO receives no new credit, and no repository- or family-level inference is allowed.

OPENEMR.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted services, private configuration and unpinned behavior are excluded.

BAHMNI_MEDICATION_ADMINISTRATION.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted services, private configuration and unpinned behavior are excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Expose patient-scoped allergy read/search and validated record create, update and delete with patient-to-allergy identity binding.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr FHIR allergy controller and services at pinned loci
evaluations.evidence_loci: openemr/openemr@312b5d042f7fa49cc78ebed041155fba339a991c :: FhirAllergyIntoleranceRestController.php :: L35-L136,L143-L226; FhirAllergyIntoleranceService.php :: L56-L63,L101-L163,L247-L264; AllergyIntoleranceService.php :: L141-L244,L248-L361
evaluations.reason: The source directly proves patient-scoped allergy read/search mapping and validated record insert/update/delete with patient and allergy ID pairing. No Site, audit, concurrency or runtime claim is inferred.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Govern a distinct emergency-contact lifecycle with classification, CRUD, delete and provenance.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr related-person sources at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Patient related-person serialization and relationship upsert do not prove emergency-contact classification, delete or target lifecycle provenance.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Retrieve immutable medication-order version history with diffs and bounded version semantics.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr medication-request sources at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Current patient/status/intent query with meta version fixed to one does not establish order-version history, diff, revert or immutable version retrieval.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Read MAR and PRN eligibility/effectiveness through a bounded patient and schedule API.
evaluations.research_candidate: Bahmni medication-administration DAO and model at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Generic administration read/search lacks PRN eligibility/effectiveness and MAR schedule/cell semantics.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Calculate multi-drug interactions with severity, evidence and governed override response semantics.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr allergy rule criterion at pinned locus
evaluations.reason: An allergy criterion and database view are not a multi-drug interaction calculation or response API.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Expose a medication-event integrity API with scoped semantics, verification and replay-safe provenance.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr generic audit logger at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Generic audit, encryption, checksum and SQL-event primitives do not establish a medication-event integrity API.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Request and grant client-specific emergency access with reason, expiry, revocation and idempotent provenance.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr break-glass checker and audit logger at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Global group membership and forced audit override do not prove client-specific request/grant lifecycle, expiry, revoke or rationale.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Review emergency-access use through an accountable oversight queue with findings and lifecycle actions.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr break-glass checker and audit logger at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The source does not implement reviewer queues, scoped review/dismiss actions, findings or oversight lifecycle state.
